hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Quick answers about orders, delivery, payment and returns.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Tap **Order Now** on any product, fill in your phone number, name and address, then confirm. No account is needed. We call you to confirm before shipping.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Inside Dhaka orders usually arrive in 1–2 days, Dhaka suburbs in 2–3 days and the rest of Bangladesh in 2–4 days. Holidays and bad weather can add a day or two.

items.question: What is the delivery charge?
items.answer: Delivery costs **৳70** inside Dhaka, **৳100** in Dhaka suburbs and **৳130** outside Dhaka. Orders of **৳3,000** or more, and products marked Free Delivery, ship free.

items.question: Can I pay with bKash or Nagad?
items.answer: Yes. Choose bKash or Nagad at checkout, send the total to the number shown and enter the transaction ID. Cash on Delivery is available all over Bangladesh too.

items.question: Can I check the product before paying?
items.answer: Yes. With Cash on Delivery you can check the product in front of the delivery person before you pay.

items.question: What if the product is faulty?
items.answer: Contact us within **7 days** of delivery. If the product has a manufacturing fault we will replace it. Keep the box and accessories so the replacement is quick.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: Open **Track Order** from the top of the site and enter your order ID and phone number. You can also search with your phone number only to see all your orders.

sections.title: What can be returned
sections.body: Products must be unused, with the original box, accessories and invoice. Damage caused by misuse, water or a fall is not covered.

sections.title: Refunds
